title: Odile · all ten at 3×
caption: Ten brand-new designs beside the CC0 pawn and knight. Judge: which two or three are Odile?

title: Odile · at game size
caption: All ten at 1× on the grass beside the pack. Judge: does any read as not an elf, or not Pixel Frog?

caption: Runs the long looms at the fords and wears her trade: a silk spool for a hat, rose thread wound on it, a shuttle held low in her fist. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Odile?
